Consider a system of linear equations $PX = Q$ where $P \in \mathbb{R}^{3 \times 3}$ and $Q \in \mathbb{R}^{3 \times 1}$. Suppose $P$ has an LU decomposition, $P = LU$, where
$$L = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ l_{21} & 1 & 0 \\ l_{31} & l_{32} & 1 \end{bmatrix} \quad \text{and} \quad U = \begin{bmatrix} u_{11} & u_{12} & u_{13} \\ 0 & u_{22} & u_{23} \\ 0 & 0 & u_{33} \end{bmatrix}$$

Which of the following statement(s) is/are TRUE?
questions.optionA: (A) The system $PX = Q$ can be solved by first solving $LY = Q$ and then $UX = Y$.
questions.optionB: (B) If $P$ is invertible, then both $L$ and $U$ are invertible.
questions.optionC: (C) If $P$ is singular, then at least one of the diagonal elements of $U$ is zero.
questions.optionD: (D) If $P$ is symmetric, then both $L$ and $U$ are symmetric.

Consider a stack data structure into which we can PUSH and POP records. Assume that each record pushed in the stack has a positive integer key and that all keys are distinct.
We wish to augment the stack data structure with an $O(1)$ time MIN operation that returns a pointer to the record with smallest key present in the stack
1) without deleting the corresponding record, and
2) without increasing the complexities of the standard stack operations.

Which one or more of the following approach(es) can achieve it?
questions.optionA: (A) Keep with every record in the stack, a pointer to the record with the smallest key below it.
questions.optionB: (B) Keep a pointer to the record with the smallest key in the stack.
questions.optionC: (C) Keep an auxiliary array in which the key values of the records in the stack are maintained in sorted order.
questions.optionD: (D) Keep a Min-Heap in which the key values of the records in the stack are maintained.

questions.subject: Computer Science & IT
questions.questionText:
Consider the following relational schema:
Students (underline{rollno}: integer, name: string, age: integer, cgpa: real)
Courses (underline{courseno}: integer, cname: string, credits: integer)
Enrolled (underline{rollno}: integer, underline{courseno}: integer, grade: string)

Which of the following options is/are correct SQL query/queries to retrieve the names of the students enrolled in course number (i.e., courseno) 1470?

(A)
```sql
SELECT S.name 
FROM Students S
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Enrolled E 
              WHERE E.courseno = 1470 
              AND E.rollno = S.rollno);
```

(B)
```sql
SELECT S.name 
FROM Students S
WHERE SIZEOF (SELECT * FROM Enrolled E
              WHERE E.courseno = 1470 
              AND E.rollno = S.rollno) > 0;
```

(C)
```sql
SELECT S.name 
FROM Students S
WHERE 0 < (SELECT COUNT(*) 
          FROM Enrolled E
          WHERE E.courseno = 1470 
          AND E.rollno = S.rollno);
```

(D)
```sql
SELECT S.name 
FROM Students S NATURAL JOIN Enrolled E
WHERE E.courseno = 1470;
```

A quadratic polynomial $(x - \alpha)(x - \beta)$ over complex numbers is said to be square invariant if $(x - \alpha)(x - \beta) = (x - \alpha^2)(x - \beta^2)$. Suppose from the set of all square invariant quadratic polynomials we choose one at random.

The probability that the roots of the chosen polynomial are equal is __________. (rounded off to one decimal place)

questions.questionText:
The unit interval $(0,1)$ is divided at a point chosen uniformly distributed over $(0,1)$ in $\mathbb{R}$ into two disjoint subintervals.

The expected length of the subinterval that contains 0.4 is __________. (rounded off to two decimal places)
